name: treasury-payments
summary: Treasury agents send Stripe test-mode transfers to named payees only: two independent approvers release every transfer, a payee whose bank details changed recently also needs the principal's step-up, a per-transfer cap and a weekly budget bound the amounts, and each transfer is verified at the domain effect.
covers: a destination set of payees: transfers to any other connected account are denied, and the grant baseline names only the payees
two independent approvals for every transfer

payout-redirection protection: a payee whose bank details changed within 7 days also needs the principal's security-key step-up, and a transfer whose payee's bank-detail changes cannot be read is refused
a per-transfer maximum of 10000.00 USD and a weekly budget of 50000.00 USD
domain-effect verification of each transfer through the Stripe connector
